quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the SOLID principles in software development?

answers.answer: To provide a framework for creating flexible and maintainable software
To ensure code is written in one programming language
To enforce strict coding standards and styles

quiz.question: How does the Single Responsibility Principle help improve code maintainability?

answers.answer: By ensuring each class has multiple functions
By ensuring each class has one clear, distinct responsibility
By enforcing a standard naming convention

quiz.question: Why should developers regularly review their code against SOLID principles?

answers.answer: To ensure the codebase uses the latest programming language features
To identify and fix performance issues
To spot and correct design flaws early in development
To make the code compatible with older software
